provenance.data: FAOSTAT Bangladesh yields (1961–2024, 26 crops) and NASA POWER daily weather at the seven upazilas (2000-10-01 to 2026-11-23)
provenance.method: Each harvest judged against the crop's own trend (a line through the 7 years either side, the year itself left out): good ≥ +4%, bad ≤ −4%. Models scored leaving one whole year out at a time.

synthetic.note: The 30 starter records of the brief, scored leaving one record out. They are made-up examples; these scores show the pipeline runs, not that a model works in the field.
